test_cases.title: Applicant adds a valid review comment to a profile section
acs: DERIVED: Applicant adds a valid review comment to a profile section - features/search/search-disease-profiles.feature:119

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 with an account that has the ProfileEditor role
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the Search disease profiles page
steps.expected: The Search disease profiles page is displayed with the search box and filters

steps.action: Enter "African Horse Sickness" in the Search for disease profiles box and click Search profiles
steps.expected: The results are reloaded for that text

steps.action: Check the search results list
steps.expected: A result named "African Horse Sickness (AHS)" is listed

steps.action: Click the Browse profile link on the first search result
steps.expected: The profile questions page for that version is displayed

steps.action: Click the Review comments tab
steps.expected: The review comments tab is displayed with the Add a review comment option

steps.action: Enter "TC-071 subject" in the Subject field
steps.expected: "TC-071 subject" is shown in the Subject field

steps.action: Enter "TC-071 reference" in the Reference field
steps.expected: "TC-071 reference" is shown in the Reference field

steps.action: Enter "TC-071 test comment" in the Comment field
steps.expected: "TC-071 test comment" is shown in the Comment field

steps.action: Click Save
steps.expected: The form closes and the comment is saved

steps.action: Check the review comments list
steps.expected: The new comment is listed with the entered subject
